title: Humility
definition: Humility is the Spirit-formed posture of lowliness before God and others, free from pride and self-exaltation.
summary: Humility is the grace-formed posture that receives everything from God and gladly lowers self for His glory and others' good.
christFocus: Jesus Christ humbled Himself to serve and save, becoming the supreme pattern of humility.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on the death of pride. Humility is not pretending to be worthless; it is seeing God, self, and others truthfully. It receives correction, serves without entitlement, and refuses to compete for glory that belongs to the Lord.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because pride hides under knowledge, service, gifting, suffering, and even ministry success. Humility keeps disciples teachable and relationships healthy. It also reflects the mind of Christ, who humbled Himself for sinners.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive correction without immediately defending yourself. Celebrate others without comparison. Pray for hidden pride to be exposed gently and replaced with gratitude.
